clauses.clause: During your turn, Radha has first strike.
clauses.evidence: Trace [cast]: 'keywords +FIRST_STRIKE' on the controller's turn; [on the opponent's turn, opp_bear attacks you] and [on the opponent's turn, you cast an instant]: 'card: keywords -FIRST_STRIKE'; [this creature attacks and opp_giant blocks it]: opp_giant is dealt 3 first, then Radha is dealt 4 (two damage steps). Packs A06_7 (her own turn: a 3/3 blocker dies before it deals damage) and A06_8 (the opponent's turn: both 3/3s die together).

clauses.clause: You may look at the top card of your library any time,
clauses.evidence: Information only: no event, no lane, no change in the trace. The tree is the static LOOK_AT {controller YOU, count 1} (the compiler's own B19-look-and-play-lands-from-top form; the executor is omniscient and records only a 'disclosure' layer record while the static is live). Judged from the tree; nothing in the game state depends on it.

clauses.clause: and you may play lands from the top of your library.
clauses.evidence: Not in the trace. Pack A06_1: the Mountain on top is played from the library as the land drop (untapped), the Forest now on top is refused (land drop spent). A06_2: a nonland top card (Walking Corpse) is not castable, a land under it is not playable. A06_3: with Radha in the hand nothing is offered. A06_4: a land on top of the opponent's library is not offered.

clauses.clause: {4}{R}{G}: Radha gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of lands you control.
clauses.evidence: Trace [activate [2] from battlefield]: 'mana C-4 G-1 R-1' (the whole cost), 'card: P/T 3/3 -> 4/4' with exactly one land under the controller's control (the board also has an opponent's land: X is 1, not 2), 'after the turn ends: card: P/T 4/4 -> 3/3'. Packs A06_5 (X = 4 with lands counted by control: an owned land the opponent controls is not counted, an opponent-owned land the controller controls is), A06_6 (gone on the next turn), A06_9 (X is fixed as the ability resolves).
